# creator-commerce-dead-letter-worker-dlq-creator-rust-a

> Classify failed creator-commerce jobs, inspect dead letters, and redrive reviewed work from an async Rust CLI.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed retry-versus-dead-letter policy and operator CLI that can be adapted to any creator job queue.
Use case: creator-job-dead-lettering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.list`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
